text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Hot debate in the National Transitional Council (CNT) over a party law submitted by the government to be voted by the council.
- Authorities ban the Signatories of the Peace Call from laying wreath in Belcourt to mourn victims of a car bomb last week.
- Gunmen kill a member of Rally for Culture and Democracy (RCD) party outside his home in Algiers.

- Political party representatives in the CNT protest at party legislation, saying they did not want to sign their own political death sentence, in reference to tightened rules governing political activities in the new party law to be voted by the council.
- The International Federation of Human Rights threatens to expel Algerian League for the Defence of Human Rights, headed by Ali Yahia Abdenour.
- The government to set up a high council for environment.
